A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 15-page paper, including Appendix A.1–A.4. Pages 2–15 have identical text and rendered content; differences are confined to the first-page author block and arXiv stamp.

before.justification: Section 4, Tables 1–4 and Figure 3 report original classification experiments on CIFAR10, CRC-Tissue, KC-Cell and 20NewsGroups.

after.justification: Section 4, Tables 1–4 and Figure 3 retain the same original experimental results on all four datasets.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical BI-based memory selection, random replay, test-time augmentation, communication burn-in and aggregation procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same CIFAR10, biomedical image and 20NewsGroups classification tasks. Dataset coverage and class selection in Section 4.1 and Appendix A.3 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–4 retain ER, CBR and the LC, MS, RC and EN uncertainty comparators. Figure 3 retains the same FedAvg and MFCL comparisons.

E3.justification: The experimental settings remain identical, including five clients, batch size 10, burn-in 30, communication every five mini-batches, memory capacities and model configurations. Appendix A.4 retains the same evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: The memory-size and top-versus-bottom uncertainty-selection comparisons are unchanged. Figure 3 retains the same task-wise accuracy and relative forgetting analyses; no additional analyses appear.

E5.justification: Both versions state that experiments use three random seeds and retain identical plus/minus uncertainty reporting in Tables 1–4.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings in Tables 1–4 and Figure 3 are identical. For example, CIFAR10 bottom-BI with memory 1000 retains accuracy 35.83 ± 2.60 and forgetting 19.07 ± 2.17.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, BI estimator in Equation 1, and uncertainty and evaluation definitions in Appendix A are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about formalizing online FCL, modality-agnostic uncertainty-based replay and reducing catastrophic forgetting.

C2.justification: The interpretations of low-BI samples and more uniform task performance are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations concerning TTA overhead and the BI estimator's finite-sample underestimation.

D1.justification: Architecture, optimizer, learning-rate, hardware and preprocessing disclosures are identical. Appendix A.2 retains the same augmentation list; no code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical, preserving the same positioning relative to continual learning, generative FCL and prior uncertainty estimation work.

P1.justification: The first page changes Florian Buettner's email from florian.buettner@dkfz.de to florian.buettner@dkfz-heidelberg.de and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The paper's prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The longer email slightly shifts the first-page author block horizontally, and the margin stamp changes. All figures, tables, captions and layouts on pages 2–15 remain identical.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations and appendices are unchanged. The contact-address update, version stamp and slight author-block repositioning establish no meaningful overall quality difference.
